name: com.neoxider.coreaimirror
description: Optional Mirror transport for CoreAI's online worlds: authenticated admission, real RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction traffic over the wire, and the server clock offset. Install it only when you run a host; without it CoreAI stays solo on the loopback bridge and nothing in this package compiles. Requires Mirror (Asset Store or UPM), which defines MIRROR — the assemblies here carry that as a define constraint, so a project without Mirror never builds them.
